text:
omar: Heads up — paging eng-platform. We're seeing noisy tenants hitting ~30k tokens/min on smaller model families (mini-llama-7b / openchat-lite). Can we discuss model-aware burst decay and how we surface it in Console?

liz: Yup — we only enforce per-key token_rate and a global burst bucket today. Model-specific caps would help preventing small models from starving capacity.

ravi: +1. Proposal: add model_family + size_tier into the rate-limiter key and use a leaky-bucket with a decay window tuned per family. Example config idea: 
```json
{"policy_name":"per-model-burst","model_family":"mini-llama","burst_capacity":5000,"decay_seconds":60,"enforcement_order":["per-key","per-org","per-model"]}
```

maya: Telemetry note — we need new metrics: tokens_consumed{model_family}, burst_credits{tenant,model_family}, and a sliding_peak_10s tokens gauge. Is that feasible? @sam can we piggyback on ingress tagging?

sam: We can, but router needs to set model_family header at ingress (x-rw-model-family). Two options: enrich at client SDK or router. Router enrichment is simplest for hosted. For Dedicated/private we can rely on customer-set header + validation. Fallback: lookup model_id->family map in the router if header missing.

liz: Console UX: show current burst credits + decay rate on the Quotas modal per model family, with a small sparkline for 1m and 1h. Also add a "Request temporary burst" CTA for org owners. Mockup: https://figma.redwood/workspace/quotas/preview (placeholder).

omar: Enforcement order question — should per-model be checked before per-org or after? If a tenant is within org limits but exceeds model-family limits, we want to 429 specifically with model_quota_exceeded.

ravi: I suggest enforcement semantics: take the min available tokens across [per-key, per-org, per-model] and subtract from it. That yields deterministic 429 reason (the tightest constraint). Also include header x-rw-rate-limit-reason.

maya: Alerting: send an early-warning when model-specific 429 rate increases >3x baseline over a 6h window + a pager if sustained for 12h. Also log example traces so SRE can triage noisy patterns.

quota-bot: policy-check: new fields required in schema -> model_family (string), burst_capacity (int), decay_window_seconds (int), enforcement_order (list).

sam: I'll pick up router changes: add header enrichment, metric tagging, and model_id->family cache. ETA: 2 weeks for hosted router + 3 weeks for dedicated flow.

liz: I'll add Console changes: quota modal + per-model line items in quota page, plus an API page explaining enforcement order. Need mockups by EOW Friday.

omar: Assign owners: sam (ingress), liz (console UX), maya (telemetry & alerts), ravi (rate-limiter impl). @all ok?

ravi: ok. I'll write RFC with algorithm details and a migration plan for existing quota configs. Plan to add an opt-in flag "model_aware_quotas" to avoid surprise production behaviour.

maya: For Dedicated we should store overrides in redis namespace `quotas:tenant:<tenant_id>:model:<family>` with ttl for temporary bursts. Also record audit events for admin actions.

sam: Backcompat: router sets header for new deployments only; rate-limiter falls back to model-id map for older calls. We'll also add a feature flag to flip enforcement order safely in canary.

omar: Great. Let's sync tomorrow 10:00am in #eng-platform or quick huddle. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
